attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: The claim keeps the 'almost two years', 'GPT-4-sized breakthrough' and '$50B' elements. The 'no real solution' clause is handled as a separate claim. Calling the anchor 'trained' is loose: the text says GPT-4 was shown to Gates in August 2022.

contract.note: Reading the claim as a broad leap comparable to GPT-4's own leap is an ordinary, fair reading. Requiring the money to be spent specifically on surpassing GPT-4 matches his wording. Neither 'breakthrough' nor 'invested' comes with a measure, so the contract's interpretation drives the result.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own announcement calls GPT-4o 'GPT-4 level', with gains in other modalities. This is a company disclosure about one firm and cannot show the whole field made no leap.
Google describes its own long-context gain as a 'breakthrough'. This is self-description by the company, and no agreed measure shows it was GPT-4-sized.
Anthropic says Claude 3 sets new benchmark records. A company announcement, with no comparison to the size of GPT-4's leap.
$25.2B of generative-AI private investment in 2023. A different metric and period from money spent specifically on going beyond GPT-4, so it does not settle the $50B claim.

reviews.rationale: The packet contains only company self-descriptions of 2024 model advances, with no comparable evaluation measuring them against GPT-4's leap. No matched financial accounting checks the $50B figure. Neither the breakthrough part nor the investment part is settled, so the claim is unresolved.

reviews.rationale: e7 and e9 alone would support the claim: in May 2024 reasoning, reliability and safeguard problems remained. However, e8 is misdated: it claims to be v1 of May 2024, but its text identifies an August 2026 version. A broken evidence item triggers abstention under the policy.
reviews.abstain_reason: Evidence item e8 is not what it claims to be: it is labelled arXiv v1 available 30 May 2024, but its text says it is a version dated August 24, 2026.
